<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Detects pulses in the input signal data_in and outputs data_out indicating the end of the detected pulse.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INITIAL">Initial state of the pulse detection process.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_1">First state of the pulse detection process.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_2">Second state of the pulse detection process.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LAST">Last state of the pulse detection process.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state">Register to hold the current state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state">Register to hold the next state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
        <reg id="data_out">Register to hold the output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</reg>
        
        <always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                INITIAL: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = STATE_1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = LAST;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_2;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_2: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_2;
                    end
                end
                
                LAST: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = LAST;
                    end
                end
                
                default: begin
                    next_state = INITIAL;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= INITIAL;
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
                
                if(next_state == LAST && data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    data_out <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    data_out <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation></implementation>
    <task></task>
</module>
